attribution_limitations: Table 3 gives a single set of interventions (repeated stimulation, oxygen supply, initial termination of opioid treatment) and a single lowest oxygen saturation (88%) for the case, while the text describes desaturations at both the day 1 pause and the day 8 event. The 88% value cannot be tied to one of the two events.
The comedication count (10 substances) is stated for the time of the first incident, while Table 3 lists four relevant comedications during OIRD; the two lists are kept as separate statements.

The text says the first attempt was paused due to "increased myoclonus, seizures, and oxygen desaturations"; it is unclear whether "increased" also applies to seizures. Seizures are recorded without the increase qualifier.
